mainEntity.name: When should I consider replacing or upgrading my window trim?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider replacing or upgrading your window trim if you notice signs of damage like rot, cracks, warping, or insect infestation. Worn-out trim can lead to drafts and reduce your home's energy efficiency. Upgrading trim is also a good idea if you're undergoing a home renovation or simply want to enhance your home's aesthetic appeal and increase its curb appeal. It's a key detail that significantly impacts your home's overall look.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider replacing or upgrading window trim if you see damage like rot or cracks, experience drafts, or want to update your home's appearance during a renovation.
